turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a snowstorm coming Thursday night and I'm supposed to drive to my sister's on Friday.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That could make the roads rough. Would you rather leave Thursday afternoon before it hits, or wait and go Saturday?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, my friend and I need to figure something out. Wait until I'm back, okay?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Do you want to watch something tonight or are you too tired?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Something short. I'll fall asleep if it's over two hours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's that animated one your sister recommended.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Oh, that's supposed to be really good. How long is it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: About an hour and a half.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Perfect. I'll make tea, you find the remote.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Deal. Do we have any of those biscuits left?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Top cupboard, if you didn't eat them all.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Any thoughts on when to drive to your sister's?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll leave Thursday right after lunch.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Good idea. Fill up the tank and pack a blanket and snacks, just in case traffic slows down.
